The active-membership SQL is copied into runCommercialCommand, runCommercialRead, runCrmCommand, runCrmCreate and runCrmRead.

problem: Commercial replay identity is (tenant, principal, operation, key) and ignores the request body. It only compares the target record when a caller passes `replayTarget`. CRM stores request_hash and refuses a different request under the same key (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED). Neither file compares the two.
